presets.label: How much the agent may do on its own
presets.careful.desc: Asks you before every file change and every command.
presets.balanced.desc: Changes files on its own; asks before running commands other than safe reads.
presets.autonomous.desc: Changes files and runs commands (tests, lint, builds) on its own, inside the run's folders.
presets.custom: A mode below is picked: Plan only reads, Bypass removes the prompts and the folder boundary.
presets.secretOff: The check for secrets before a commit is off.
presets.secretOn: Turn on Checks with the secret scan
presets.secretIsOn: On: a commit that adds something that looks like a password, token or key asks you first.
presets.section.name: Agents
presets.section.title: Safety presets
presets.section.desc: Three plain choices for how much a run may do without asking. They pick one of the permission modes; the hard stops (no commit or push, no secrets, nothing outside the run's folders) are the same in all of them.
presets.section.defaultOther: New runs start in another mode (Plan); pick a preset to change that.
presets.section.enable: Show the presets in the New Run dialog
presets.section.enableDesc: Above the permission cards. Plan and Bypass stay on the cards; Bypass always asks for its typed confirmation.
presets.section.hardStopsDesc: Without a choice here, a new run starts in the mode of the last run. Plan and Bypass are never a default.
presets.section.secretDesc: Before a commit, the changed lines are scanned for values that look like passwords, tokens or keys (part of the Checks extra).
